title: Partial Collection List native coverage
scope: L01-L08 planning matrix; exact native evidence currently covers bounded L01-L03 and a manually authored card-basis setup only.
coverage_policy: A row is evidenced only by the named native DOM/computed/reload record. Unrecorded controls remain unverified; this is representative coverage, not an exhaustive setting or runtime claim.

fixture_limits: All category values are Accessibility; mixed-category filter semantics are not represented.
The fixture has no numeric or date fields for numeric/date sorting and comparison cases.
Representative authored values do not exhaust arbitrary field values, collection sizes, or responsive settings.

cases.purpose: Create a Collection List, bind title content, and verify empty/no-source states after reload.
proof: Bound source repeats the 18 published fixture titles at Desktop, Tablet, and Mobile after reload.
Empty source and no-source public states render zero lists/headings at all three devices.
The setup record documents the empty Bind-fields guidance and List template-column insertion flow.

cases.purpose: Grid/Slider layout and responsive Wrap behavior after reload.
proof: Grid Wrap is recorded at all three devices with 18 items and no page overflow.
Slider is recorded at all three devices with nowrap, overflow-x:auto, and no page overflow.
Grid No wrap is recorded at all three devices; Mobile has pageOverflow true with scrollWidth 395 versus width 374.
limits: No-wrap behavior is intentionally preserved; the Mobile overflow is unresolved and is not counted as a pass.

cases.purpose: Sort by title and direction, including CMS order, across reload/device states.
proof: CMS order matches published fixture order at Desktop, Tablet, and Mobile.
Title A–Z and Z–A actual arrays match their expected arrays at all three devices.
The lexical order is the renderer's localeCompare order, so 11 precedes 2 in A–Z.

cases.purpose: Filter/Test/Value behavior, including category and title contains cases.
limits: No native filter evidence is persisted in this candidate; fixture category is homogeneous Accessibility and has no numeric/date fields.

cases.purpose: Items per page, Show at most, precedence, and reload.
